message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 周六能帮我送只猫去领养日吗

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 我一个人搞不定 猫笼太重

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 行 几点 在哪

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 十点 救助站门口

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 猫有猫癣 得单独放 你别嫌麻烦

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 对了 我周六上午可能要去学校开家长会

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 开到十一点 不知道来不来得及

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 那我十点先到 你开完会直接来

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 它叫年糕 你看

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 是不是长得不太像能领养出去的

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 今天有只猫被退回来了

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 领养人说它抓沙发 养了三天就送回来

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 我有点不知道该不该继续送养

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 周六可能去不了 你自己安排吧

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 我这周有点丧 想自己待着

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 其实还是想你去

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 我一个人真搞不定 年糕又重

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 行 周六我全程帮你拎

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 你为什么愿意帮我

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 我是说 你不觉得救助站很麻烦吗

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 救助站说要家访

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 你要不要一起 我一个人去有点慌

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 今天多亏你 年糕安顿好了

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 晚上请你吃饭吧 就当谢你

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 行 你挑地方 我七点到

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 别多想 就是感谢

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 不过你要真想多想 我也拦不住

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 昨天那顿饭吃得挺舒服

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 年糕的新主人发照片来了 我先不聊了 去改作业
